craft_notes: Sthāyin: pervasion proved — closing coronation. Rows: pride, proof, chain. Read aloud: final ascent.

lines: Alone it is the strand's pride: without it, no other strand stands;
hence earth-truth, from Śiva-truth on, by water-truth is spread —
so water by glow, and the rest, till might-truth.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sa eva guṇasya utkarṣo yat tena vinā guṇāntaraṃ na upapadyate tena pṛthivītattvaṃ śivatattvāt prabhṛti jalatattvena vyāptam evaṃ jalaṃ tejasā ityādi yāvac chaktitattvam
